_comment: A retraction is not complete until the retracted string is absent from the
tree. Each entry is one retirement. `pattern` is a regex matched against
WHITESPACE-FLATTENED text, so a wrapped phrase cannot slip through a
line-based grep. `marker_window` is how many characters around a hit are
searched for a retraction marker: a hit that sits inside an explicit
withdrawal is the record doing its job, not a survival.
Seed the bank when a claim is retired, in the same commit that retires it.

entries.why: positivity was never the test for the leave-one-out arms; the threshold is 2.706 and the arms span a factor of fourteen
a binary count of leave-one-out arms is not a stable summary: the arms are separate likelihoods and carrying them to the adopted kappa leaves one inside the profile's own scatter of the threshold
withdrawn on the same rows it cited

entries.pattern: only the DIFFERENTIAL[a-z ]{0,40}can bias a width
entries.why: beta.py floats a centre per trace and density is constant within a trace, so a collisional shift is absorbed whether or not it varies across the sweep
an intermediate draft of the Orson density-null comparison; the committed like-for-like figure is about 24

entries.pattern: (?:homogeneous terms|these four|components of th\w+ response|transit[^.]{0,60}) adds? exactly|adds? exactly[^.]{0,60}transit
entries.why: the guided transit kernel is a squared Lorentzian entering the width at second order (results/transit_additivity.csv temperature_exponent_band 0.97 to 0.98), so the four-term exact-additivity model is retired; exact additivity survives for the Lorentzian pair alone. Survived 14 board rounds in files no round was pointed at, and two clean-sweep greps missed it on grammatical number
the whole-line odd cumulants survive only as the truncation-limited, self-centred fraction results/cumulant_window_check.csv measures; the unqualified pass-through claim is the retracted form
suppression wording implies a ratio below one; the measured quantity is a truncation-limited fraction and the correct wording names the fraction and its rows
the small-shift ratio is finite (survival_vs_S0 rows); the floor-domination story was grid noise from edge-snapped windows, and floor already means the noise floor in this record
E73: the pedestal is symmetric by construction and the data's own symmetry at |k| = 3 refuses only an antisymmetric excess of that size; the phrase asserted more than either

entries.pattern: rather than electronics or dark current
entries.why: E72: the floor scales with the peak height, an electronic component is bounded and not excluded

E76: the lineage waist is a working convention (owner, 2026-09-10), and the results ledger's generator still called it an independent measurement. Generalised 2026-09-22 (O44) from the one retired number to any number: no waist of any size has ever been independently measured on this bench, so the claim is false whichever number it names
E78: the van der Waals module blamed its 18 per cent miss on the 7S rate on the dropped core polarizability, where the cause was its integral's sign error on an excited atom's downward lines (A250)

owner order O32: this record MODELS the light shift -- the ramp is a term of the forward model, its higher moments are the main aim's own channel and the S0 channel is a measurement -- so a drive power at which the shift reaches a tenth of the line width is not a ceiling the bench must stay under. It also inverts with the waist: at 40 to 45 um the construct falls below the archive's own 225 mW, which would make the dataset illegal by its own table. What bounds the drive power is saturation, the companion, depletion and the ruler, each priced where it belongs
the same construct named by its rung (O32). The phrase returned twice from its own prose after the rows were first questioned, which is why it is banned by pattern and not by memory

entries.pattern: power at which\W{0,12}S0\W{0,12}=\W{0,3}natural width|light shift, not available power, sets the ceiling|(hot fill|cold), at the usable power
entries.why: F147, owner order O32 in the guided geometry: the row 'proj_guided_power_ceiling' (the drive power at which the on-axis shift equals the 6S natural width) and the two 'usable power' count rates computed at it were the same construct the order strips from the cell, carried into the fibre arm under another name; the shift is a term of the forward model and its higher moments are the main aim's channel there too. What bounds the guided drive power is saturation, depletion, the trap's own differential shift and, for the 1324/1367 nm readout, the guide's reabsorption bound, each priced where it belongs

entries.pattern: agrees well with the theoretical value|in agreement with (Hagel|the theoretical value of)\W{0,3}6\.58
entries.why: F263, T0al: Lee 2010's theoretical -6.58 Hz/(mW/mm^2) divides Hagel's -58 Hz/mW by the area of a disk of DIAMETER 0.38 mm where Hagel prints a WAIST of 0.38 mm, so the figure is four times low and the measured -7.25(45) sits near four times below theory; the measured coefficients stand, the agreement does not.
